
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /reset                                     │
  │  Reset Learning Data                        │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Reset a category of learned data or the token budget.

  Usage:
    /reset
    /reset <category>

  Details:
    Reset specific learning categories:
    
      • budget       — Reset token budget counters
      • preferences  — Reset learned code style
      • errors       — Reset error patterns
      • examples     — Reset few-shot examples
      • tools        — Reset tool effectiveness data
      • reflections  — Reset task reflections
      • all          — Reset everything

  Examples:
    $ /reset budget
    $ /reset preferences
    $ /reset all

  Related: /stats
